product_one_liner.value: Sauce Labs provides an AI-powered cloud platform that authors, runs, analyzes and heals web and mobile tests for enterprise software development and quality-assurance teams.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering/open-source blog describes the Real Device Cloud search implementation and the DevTools UI build, artifact-storage and delivery infrastructure in two separate posts.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public application page lists AI Architect in Gurugram, India.

model_provider.notes: The company’s AI Architect posting explicitly describes integration with “our self-hosted versions of Gemini Flash models.” This establishes a publicly named model, not that every AI feature uses it.

compliance_certs.notes: The company claims SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a regulatory-compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Funding databases report a January 2024 Series G (Indexed labels it Series G+) and Indexed reports $79.9 million. This later round is not corroborated by a company announcement located in this research; the company’s June 2022 TPG announcement does not disclose an amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round in the located funding histories is January 2024, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window; the latest located company funding announcement is June 2022.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The public application page lists Account Executive in London, UK.

launched_6mo.notes: AURA launched July 22, 2026, inside the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: April 16, 2026 announcement: Steven Fitz appointed Chief Revenue Officer and Arun Lal appointed SVP, Global Marketing, within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Job-post and customer-story evidence names these systems. The customer story describes migration from Marketo to Inflection, so Marketo is a historical stack signal rather than an unqualified current-use claim.
